displayName: Dick's Sporting Goods API - Clearance, Per-Size Prices, Store Stock
description: Dick's Sporting Goods product data as structured JSON - search dickssportinggoods.com or browse any category, a brand, or the Clearance, Sale and This Week's Deals lists, 48 products per page by default (up to 144) with the current and list price range, percent off, rating, review count, badge, colors, merchandised items flagged and the offer-price windows Dick's has planned, filtered by brand, an approximate price range or any facet (gender, size, color, rating, sale); read one product with every SKU's own price, list price, percent off, clearance flag, UPC and online units (sizes and colors are priced separately), or a fast style-level summary of up to 5 products in one call; get unit counts for up to 20 SKUs at up to 100 Dick's, Golf Galaxy or Public Lands stores near a ZIP with each store's address, phone and hours; read the 15 newest reviews with the rating statistics; pull search suggestions. 9 endpoints, 1 credit each; product and reviews 2.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
